svg.text: Figure 1. One human UMI demonstration → a style-conserving policy: every model of the current phase, exactly
Phase A of umi_style_dream (Data Scaling Laws, arrange mouse, env 17). Parameter counts are read from the checkpoints used; layer widths and depths from their configs.
arrows: tensors (shape) · d = width · L = layers · h = heads
real-to-sim from one demo (top), learning in 2,048 randomised copies of the rebuilt scene (bottom)
TCP pose Tt ∈ SE(3), width wt
written into the model per world
trained on the style prior + noise
residual on the style prior + tempo
ot ∈ ℝ40 → at ∈ ℝ5 at 10 Hz
Franka hand on an x-y-z-yaw gantry
run once per demo, on the keyframe and each object; every block is one module of the checkpoint
L 6 · d 256 · h 8 · 200 queries + presence token
pixel decoder: 3 conv + norms · mask MLP (3)
→ masks + scores (mouse 0.97, pad 0.99) · tracker 19.5 M unused (video only)
RANSAC table plane (3.1° from the tag)
scaled so the camera sits 0.28 m
in, per object: RGB crop + mask 518² · point map 256² (MoGe, metric)
→ mesh (~1.2 M triangles) + pose in the table frame, 12-21 s per object on an A100, 18 GB peak
in: object crop 224² · DB photos / names
cosine kNN, z-scored over the DB
Learned in the randomised Steel worlds (phase A)
the dreamer is trained first and frozen; three policies are trained on it: dreams + RL (ours), RL only, dreams only
Dreamer Mψ: recurrent state-space model (RSSM) · 3,300,520 parameters
in dreams ẑt ~ p(zt | ht) replaces zt (no ot)
L = ‖ôt − ot‖² + 0.5 · max(1, KL[sg(q) ‖ p]) + 0.1 · max(1, KL[q ‖ sg(p)]) (DreamerV3 KL balance, free bits 1)
Adam 3·10⁻⁴ · 8,000 steps · batch 512 sequences × 32 steps · grad clip 100
data: 4 episodes × 2,048 worlds × 131 observations from the style prior with AR(1) action noise (σ ≤ 0.5),
tempo e±0.35 and a ±0.4 width-command offset · in dreams the measured geometry (extents, widths) is held
Policy πθ (residual + tempo) and critic vφ · 1,146,381 parameters
Style model zD (not learned): the demo retargeted to this world
pref(φ) = as + L·prog(u)·e + L·dev(u)·[n, b] per phase (reach, carry, retreat), 48-point grids; yaw_ref, wref
clock φ ← φ + κΔt; each phase re-anchored at the actual TCP; 2 cm clearance near the object
astyle = [clip((pref(φ + κΔt) − p) / (vmax Δt)), yaw rate, width command] ∈ ℝ5
ht, zt from the dreamer (filtered on o≤t) · ot from Steel · the rest from the style model
at = clip(astyle(φ + κΔt) + Δa, −1, 1) = [vx, vy, vz (±0.45 m/s), yaw rate (±2 rad/s), width (0-80 mm)]
κ = exp(0.35 · tanh κraw) ∈ [0.70, 1.42]; 10 Hz → gantry and Franka hand position targets
mean (test) or sample (training) of (Δa ∈ ℝ5, κraw)
PPO on actual Steel rollouts: clip 0.2 · 4 epochs × 8 minibatches · GAE λ 0.95 · γ 0.99 · entropy 10⁻³
dreams: 10-step imagination from 8,192 actual states (every 4th minibatch), loss −E[w Gλ], w = replay gate
critic: (v − Ractual)² + 0.5 (v − sg Gλdream)² · Adam 3·10⁻⁴ · grad clip 1
reward × 0.1: γΦ(o′) − Φ(o) + 0.25 success + 10 final success + 0.25 rstyle − 0.05‖Δa‖² − 0.5 log²κ
Components that are not learned (listed for completeness)
table plane in the point map
a stable hull face flat on the table
on the pad, upright, slow, open
Test time: what the policy receives and returns, every 0.1 s
one held-out world (hidden from the policy: mouse 41 g, friction 1.44, table 0.84, grip limit 20.6 N, pad 73 g); controller: retarget-and-replay, success
t = 0.0 s · start · phase 0 (φ = 0.0 s of demo time)
t = 3.4 s · grasp · phase 1 (φ = 3.4 s of demo time)
t = 5.0 s · carry · phase 1 (φ = 5.0 s of demo time)
t = 6.4 s · release · phase 2 (φ = 6.4 s of demo time)

Before the policies finish training the controller is retarget-and-replay through the same code path (zero residual, κ = 1); the trained πθ adds Δa and κ. No images at test time: the policy acts on simulator state, as a teacher for a later VLA.
